narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Two thousand eight hundred ends in two zeros, so it is a perfect square.
<bookmark mark='lone'/>Its primes are four twos, two fives and one seven, and the seven has no partner.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Two end zeros are not enough, because every prime needs a partner.
